sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Part 6 指涉、時間順序、倒裝句、要求式假設語氣、篇章連接詞
sections.markdown:
主題：**Part 6 指涉、時間順序、倒裝句、要求式假設語氣、篇章連接詞**

### 規則 1

This/These/It/They 必須有明確先行詞

### 規則 2

Hardly/Scarcely/No sooner 句首使用倒裝

### 規則 3

Only after/Not until 句首使用 did + subject + base verb

### 規則 4

recommend/request/require + that + subject + base verb

### 規則 5

However 表轉折，Therefore 表因果，Meanwhile 表同時

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Software Release
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: Are we still launching the new application on Friday? Woman: The development work is finished, but Security found two issues during testing. They expect to complete another review Thursday afternoon. Man: So should I tell everyone Friday is confirmed? Woman: I wouldn't announce Friday just yet. If Security clears both issues, we can proceed. Otherwise, we'll move the launch to Monday. Man: All right. I'll prepare both versions of the schedule and wait for the review result.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Delivery Selection
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> We need twenty sample boxes at the laboratory no later than ten fifteen Wednesday morning. The products must remain refrigerated, and a signature is required on delivery. We have a maximum shipping budget of two hundred ninety dollars. Service A arrives five minutes too late, Service B is not refrigerated, and Service D does not include signature confirmation. Please reserve the remaining suitable option.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Maintenance Update
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, HR portal users. Maintenance was originally scheduled to end Monday at ten in the morning. The vendor now expects the portal to reopen at noon. During the outage, previously downloaded reports remain available, but no new forms can be submitted. Forms originally due Monday at five may now be submitted until Tuesday at noon. Automated reminder messages may still display Monday's deadline, but the extension remains valid.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Equipment Lease and Service Credit
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### Lease Terms

> Office scanners lease for $220 per unit per month. Orders of 5 or more units receive a 10% discount on the monthly equipment subtotal. Installation costs $180 per order and is not discounted. If delivery is more than two business days later than the confirmed delivery date, the customer receives a $100 service credit on the next month's invoice. Service credits do not reduce the current month's invoice. Optional maintenance coverage costs $25 per unit per month.

用途：參考文件

### Customer Order

> Riverstone Accounting ordered 5 scanners. Confirmed delivery date: September 8. Actual delivery date: September 11. Installation completed September 11. Maintenance coverage was selected for all five units. September budget: $1,350. October budget: $1,200.

用途：參考文件

### Vendor Confirmation

> Because the scanners arrived three business days late, Riverstone qualifies for a $100 service credit. The credit will appear on the October invoice. September charges remain unchanged. Monthly lease charges and maintenance coverage continue unless canceled. Maintenance cancellation requests for October must be received by September 25.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑦ Part 5 仿真題｜15 題
⑧ Part 6 篇章填空｜4 題
sections.markdown:
限時：**2 分 30 秒**。

### 閱讀文章

> The updated purchasing procedure will take effect next Monday. [1] _____, all purchase requests over $5,000 must receive Finance approval before being sent to Procurement. [2] _____ This requirement is intended to prevent unapproved expenditures. Requests already approved under the previous procedure will remain valid. Once Finance approval is obtained, the request [3] _____ directly to Procurement. [4] _____

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
依照首次作答結果整理錯題，優先複習出現頻率最高的標籤。

錯題標籤：

- `G`：Grammar
- `P`：Part 6 / Passage Logic
- `AGR`：Agreement
- `L`：Listening
- `IMP`：Implication
- `I`：Information Integration
- `U`：Updated Information
- `E`：Exception
- `T`：Timeline
- `CAL`：Calculation
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint
- `N`：Next Action

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- Review 30 vocabulary items twice
- Redo Part 5 within 3 minutes
- Redo Part 6 and explain paragraph logic
- Listen to all three sets twice, second round at 1.1x
- Recalculate September and October lease totals
- Redo Day 38 quiz within 4 minutes 30 seconds

questions.prompt: Why has the software not been released?
questions.explanation: Development is finished, but Security found two issues and another review is still pending.

questions.prompt: What does the woman mean by “I wouldn't announce Friday just yet”?

options.B: The announcement has already been sent.

questions.explanation: She advises against announcing Friday because the Security review may still force the launch to move to Monday.

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do next?
questions.explanation: He says he will prepare both versions of the schedule and wait for the review result.

questions.prompt: Why is Service A unsuitable?
questions.explanation: Service A arrives at 10:20, which is later than the 10:15 deadline.

questions.prompt: Why is Service B unsuitable?
questions.explanation: The shipment must remain refrigerated, but Service B does not provide refrigeration.

questions.prompt: Which service should be selected?
questions.explanation: Service C meets the arrival deadline, capacity, refrigeration, signature, and budget requirements.

questions.prompt: What will probably happen next?
questions.explanation: The speaker explicitly asks to reserve the remaining suitable option, which is Service C.

questions.prompt: When is the system now expected to reopen?
questions.explanation: The updated reopening time is noon.

questions.prompt: What can employees do during the outage?
questions.explanation: Previously downloaded reports remain available, but new forms cannot be submitted.

questions.prompt: What is the updated submission deadline?
questions.explanation: Forms originally due Monday at 5 may now be submitted until Tuesday at noon.

questions.prompt: What should employees understand about reminder emails?

options.A: They may still show the old deadline.

questions.explanation: Automated reminders may still display Monday's deadline, but the extension remains valid.

questions.prompt: What is the monthly scanner subtotal before discount?
What is the discounted monthly scanner cost?
questions.explanation: The order qualifies for a 10% discount: $1,100 × 0.90 = $990.

questions.prompt: How much is the monthly maintenance cost?
questions.explanation: 5 scanners × $25 maintenance = $125.

questions.prompt: What is the September invoice total?
questions.explanation: $990 discounted lease + $125 maintenance + $180 installation = $1,295.

questions.prompt: Does September stay within the $1,350 budget?
What is the October total if maintenance remains active?
questions.explanation: $990 lease + $125 maintenance - $100 credit = $1,015.

questions.prompt: What is the October total if maintenance is canceled in time?
questions.explanation: $990 lease - $100 service credit = $890.

questions.prompt: What must Riverstone do to remove October maintenance charges?
questions.explanation: The vendor states that cancellation requests for October maintenance must be received by September 25.

questions.prompt: Hardly _____ the meeting begun when the network failed.
questions.explanation: Hardly + had + subject + past participle.

questions.prompt: Only after the invoice was corrected _____ Accounting approve payment.
questions.explanation: Only after at the beginning triggers inversion: did + subject + base verb.

questions.prompt: The director requested that the final document _____ reviewed again.
questions.explanation: request that + subject + base verb; passive form is be reviewed.

questions.prompt: The documents _____ yesterday are ready for filing.
questions.explanation: The documents were received, so use the past participle.

questions.prompt: The shipment arrived late. _____, installation had to be postponed.
questions.explanation: The late shipment caused the postponement, so Therefore is correct.

questions.prompt: The equipment cannot be released _____ inspection is complete.
questions.explanation: Unless expresses the required condition.

questions.prompt: Please keep a copy _____ the original is lost.
questions.explanation: In case expresses a precaution.

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the technicians _____ available.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, technicians.

questions.prompt: The report, along with the attachments, _____ complete.
questions.explanation: The main subject is report, which is singular.

questions.prompt: A number of clients _____ requested revised quotations.
questions.explanation: A number of + plural noun takes a plural verb.

questions.prompt: The number of delayed shipments _____ decreased.
questions.explanation: The number of + plural noun takes a singular verb.

questions.prompt: The company agreed to _____ the late fee.
questions.explanation: agree to + base verb.

questions.prompt: The system is fully _____ with the existing hardware.
questions.explanation: After is, an adjective is needed: compatible.

questions.prompt: The extension will remain valid _____ the revised deadline.
questions.explanation: Through means up to and including the stated deadline.

questions.prompt: The customer is eligible _____ a service credit.
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is eligible for.

questions.prompt: 請選出第 1 空的正確答案。
questions.explanation: Beginning that day refers directly to the new procedure's effective date next Monday.

questions.prompt: 請選出第 2 空的正確答案。

options.A: Employees should therefore submit large purchases directly to suppliers.
options.B: Managers should check the approval status before forwarding a request.
options.C: The company will reduce salaries next month.

questions.explanation: This logically follows the Finance-approval requirement and leads into the sentence about preventing unapproved expenditures.

questions.prompt: 請選出第 3 空的正確答案。
questions.explanation: The request receives the action, so future passive voice is required: will be sent.

questions.prompt: 請選出第 4 空的正確答案。

options.A: This sequence will help ensure that every large purchase has proper authorization.
options.B: The old office will close Friday.

questions.explanation: This sequence refers to the approval-then-forwarding process described immediately before it.

questions.prompt: Not until the revised schedule was approved _____ the team notify customers.
questions.explanation: Not until at the beginning triggers inversion: did + subject + base verb.

questions.prompt: The committee recommended that the equipment _____ inspected again.
questions.explanation: recommend that + subject + base verb; passive form is be inspected.

questions.prompt: The original deadline has passed. _____, affected customers have been granted an extension.
questions.explanation: The second sentence contrasts with the fact that the original deadline has passed.

questions.prompt: The applications _____ before noon will receive priority.
questions.explanation: Applications are submitted, so the past participle is needed.

questions.prompt: How many units can arrive Thursday?
questions.explanation: The speaker says twenty-two units can be delivered Thursday morning.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply?
questions.explanation: Twenty-two units arrive Thursday and only twenty are needed Friday, so the first shipment is enough.

questions.prompt: What is the new briefing time?
questions.explanation: The updated time is 1:40 P.M.

questions.prompt: What is the deadline for requesting interpretation?
questions.explanation: Participants requiring interpretation must contact Administration by noon Friday.

questions.prompt: What is the total cost?
How much budget remains?
Why does Mia qualify for the fee exception?

options.B: The organizer changed the session date.

questions.explanation: The organizer changed the session date, creating a special exception for affected participants.

questions.prompt: What fee applies?
questions.explanation: Mia's October 23 request falls within the fee-free exception through October 24.
